method: AB 3.2.1 R1–R5 O1–O7; source gate only, not outcome analysis
question: Are independent RCT leaderboard datasets legally reusable with participant assignment roster incl nonrespondents and pre-outcome exposure, avoiding already-published effects?

sources.population: 286 finance professionals; within-subject rank displayed/absent randomized block order; piece rates between-subject; source-paper openly accessible CC BY, dataset rights NOT YET VERIFIED
890 consenting students randomized into Control 272, Goals 330, Social Goals leaderboard 288; original includes software access logs

sources.paper: Rank Incentives and Social Learning, IZA DP12437
sources.population: 1101 participants randomized to five variants, original full student roster existed; reuse license not identified
N427 random assignment to five leaderboard feedback variants and control; specific raw data rights not verified

planned_test: One read-only OSF API inspection (osf.io/v2/nodes/ujncd/, followed at most once by files API if public); retrieve status, license ID/string, registration/ethics metadata, high-level filenames and sizes, no human dataset bytes, no DOI discovery guessing
success: Exact dataset-specific public license and disclosed files with assignment and opportunity logs; only then consider schema/bytes after separate prereg and privacy check.
negative_controls: Do not confuse article CC BY with OSF dataset license
If OSF API returns 403/429/invalid JSON, stop; no circumvention
No human rows, filenames only, no GitHub archival copies of microdata
Do not confuse randomized within-subject ranking with observed screen impressions or a political forecasting tournament

science_gate.treatment: randomized rank feedback and its timing
science_gate.outcomes: effort allocation between ranked and unranked tasks
science_gate.must_falsify: Predictions distinctive from Stefan 2023 original ranking substitution effect, not reproduce already-known effect
science_gate.claim_grade: 0/3 unless executed independent test with clear novelty and competitor

stop_rule: R5 if license/data unavailable or no additional discriminant evidence, preserve two legacy slots
